text:
marta: Quick smoke test question — before we announce the default-model pin deprecation timeline, can someone sanity-check the client fallback behavior?

alex: sure. what exactly do you want tested? :thinking_face:

marta: mainly two things: 1) header negotiation when Accept-Model is missing, and 2) fallback to pinned model when the requested model isn't available. small checklist would be great.

ciara: for (1) we should confirm legacy SDKs that don't set Accept-Model still get the current default for 30d, then start returning a deprecation warning header. for (2) ensure the client gets a 200 with a `model_used` field, not a 5xx.

sam: agree. also verify streaming edge cases — if fallback happens mid-stream we should add `x-model-fallback: true` header and close stream gracefully.

marta: perfect. i'll run the smoke script against staging. can you drop the curl example we should use so SEs can reproduce?

alex: drop this in the thread and i'll wire it into the canary job:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_STAGING_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
```

ciara: add an explicit Accept-Model test:
```bash
# explicit model header
curl -i -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_STAGING_KEY" \
  -H "Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-small@v2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
```

marta: thanks. expected behaviors for the smoke: list form so I can tick off in PR notes —
- missing Accept-Model: returns 200, includes `warning: Accept-Model-deprecation` header after cutoff date
- explicit Accept-Model supported: returns 200 and `model_used` = requested if available
- explicit Accept-Model unavailable: returns 200, `model_used` = pinned-default and `x-model-fallback: true` header
- streaming fallback: final chunk includes metadata line `{"model_used":"...","fallback":true}` before EOF

sam: small nit — the `warning` header should be short, e.g. `Warning: 299 Accept-Model deprecated; see /docs/pinning` so CDNs and SDKs pick it up.

ciara: also confirm our GA event `model_pin_fallback` fires once per-request when fallback happens. that affects billing and billing tags.

alex: will add that to the test harness. i can run 1k synthetic requests and assert metrics. can we agree on the deprecation cutover window?

marta: proposal: announce today, 60d grace where SDKs get soft warning, 90d full enforcement (clients must send Accept-Model or pin). asking PM for signoff but want eng alignment.

ciara: 60/90 seems reasonable but we must include a hard opt-out policy for enterprise tenants on dedicated infra — add to comms.

sam: logging/observability ask: include `accept_model` and `model_used` in request span tags so we can slice errors by mismatch during rollout.

marta: noted. one more: can we add a small compatibility header for older SDKs to detect fallback in-app? maybe `X-Compat-Fallback: v1`

alex: i'd prefer we stick to `x-model-fallback` only; adding extra header versions confuses clients. we can put version in the JSON meta instead.

marta: ok settled. i'll open a PR with the smoke checklist and add the curl snippets. tagging @ciara @alex for quick review.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for commit 7b3f2a (api-pin-fallback-tests) :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: alert triggered: load spike on staging during synthetic run, automatically scaled pods +2.

ciara: saw the synthetic run — metrics look clean. one failing case: when the model binary is evicted mid-request we returned a 502 instead of graceful fallback. filing a bug: ENG-4829.

sam: ack, i'll take ENG-4829. plan: detect eviction and trigger immediate fallback path in runtime before returning upstream error.

marta: thanks team — i'll update the deprecation doc with the 60/90 timeline and the exception for enterprise. will ping PM after the PR. :thumbsup:
